about: Registry of original, parameterised visual templates. Parameter schemas here are the single source of truth for both the Python verifier (tools/visuals.py) and the browser renderer (web/js/visuals/). A published question references {template, version, params}. A new version must be added (never edit the meaning of a published version). Status must be 'approved' (human review) before a question using the template can be published.

templates.title: Likestrømskrets
templates.description: Ideal DC source with 1–3 resistors in series or 2–3 in parallel, optional ideal ammeter and voltmeter. Meter readings are computed from the circuit (never typed in), so they cannot contradict Ohm's law.
templates.idealised: Ideell spenningskilde (ingen indre motstand), ideelle måleinstrumenter og ledninger uten motstand.

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)
Re-approved: optional internal resistance in series circuits and name-only resistor labels (existing figures unchanged)

templates.title: Vekselstrømskrets
templates.description: Sinusoidal AC source driving a single resistor, capacitor or inductor. Optional labels for frequency, RMS voltage, component value and reactance (value or '?'); reactance and current are computed.
templates.idealised: Ideell sinusformet kilde og ideell komponent (ingen tap eller parasittiske egenskaper).

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).

templates.title: Kurveform
templates.description: One or two periodic waveforms plotted from their mathematical definition against time, with optional markers for peak, peak-to-peak, period and RMS of the first trace.

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)

templates.title: Blokkskjema
templates.description: Signal chain of labelled blocks from left to right, with up to three side blocks feeding into a chain block (e.g. a local oscillator into a mixer). Any block can be hidden ('?') or highlighted.
templates.idealised: Forenklet funksjonell oversikt, ikke et koblingsskjema.

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)

templates.title: Krets med R, C og L
templates.description: One to three resistors, capacitors and/or inductors in series or parallel, alone between two terminals or connected to a DC or AC source (optionally with an open switch). Totals, reactances, impedance, time constant and resonance frequency are computed; a capacitor or coil can instead be labelled by a given reactance (reactance_ohms). label_style: 'values' (default), 'names' (component names only, for concept questions) or 'source' (source values shown, components by name).
templates.idealised: Ideelle komponenter og ledninger uten motstand; ingen kobling mellom spolene.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.
Re-approved after adding reactance labels and the source label style
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)
Re-approved: horizontal coils drawn with their turns above the wire (no values changed)
Assumption text drops coil coupling when there is only one coil; drawing unchanged

templates.title: Likeretter
templates.description: Half-wave (one diode) or bridge (four diodes) rectifier fed from an AC source, with optional reservoir/filter capacitor and load resistor. Also draws a simple diode detector (half-wave with C and R in parallel).
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema. Diodene er tegnet slik at plussiden av utgangen er øverst.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.
Re-approved: centre-tap kind added (existing figures unchanged)

templates.title: Transformator
templates.description: Transformer with AC source on the primary and an optional load on the secondary. Turns can be shown as numbers or as a ratio; secondary voltage and input impedance are computed.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.

templates.title: Transistortrinn
templates.description: NPN common-emitter stage: collector resistor to the supply, optional emitter resistor with optional bypass capacitor, optional base voltage divider and coupling capacitors. Node voltages and collector current can be labelled with a value or '?'.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema av et forsterkertrinn med NPN-transistor.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.
Re-approved: optional base resistor from the supply (existing figures unchanged)

templates.title: Spenningsregulator med serietransistor
templates.description: Linear series regulator: NPN pass transistor between input and output, base fed through a resistor from the input and held by a zener diode to ground, load at the output, optional input capacitor. Input/output voltage and load current are shown as values or '?'; the voltage across and the power in the pass transistor are computed.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema av en lineær spenningsregulator.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0075
Re-approved: voltage labels moved under the terminals so the figure fits phones (no values changed)

templates.title: Zenerdiode med seriemotstand
templates.description: Simple zener voltage reference: a DC input feeds a zener diode to ground through a series resistor R, and the zener voltage is taken out at the output terminals. Input voltage, zener voltage and current are shown as values or '?'; the voltage across R and R itself are computed.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema. Zenerdioden regnes å holde spenningen sin konstant, og strømmen som trekkes på utgangen er neglisjerbar.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0158

templates.title: Frekvensrespons og spektrum
templates.description: Curves against frequency, computed from their definition: filter curves in dB with their −6 dB and −60 dB widths, a resonance curve with its half-power points (and optionally a frequency band on the curve), the spectrum of an AM or FM signal modulated with one tone, or the response of two coupled tuned circuits at different coupling. 'blank' draws only the axes with a note, for figures that are filled in after answering.
templates.idealised: Kurvene er regnet ut fra en forenklet modell og viser formen, ikke et bestemt filter eller apparat.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures for q-0115, q-0053, q-0051, q-0213, q-0021, q-0197, q-0114
AM description names lower/upper sideband and says lower amplitude; frequency labels keep the value's own decimals; drawings unchanged

templates.title: Pi-filter
templates.description: Pi-filter (low-pass) at a transmitter output: variable capacitor C1 across the input, coil L in series (optionally with a band tap), variable capacitor C2 across the output. Optionally fed from a valve anode through a blocking capacitor with the anode voltage brought in through an RF choke. One part can be marked with a dashed frame, and the knob names TUNE/LOAD can be shown (typically only after answering).

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0171

templates.title: Forholdsdetektor
templates.description: Simplified ratio detector (FM demodulator): tuned MF transformer with a centre-tapped secondary, two diodes the same way round the loop charging C3 and C4 (U1, U2), a large capacitor Cs across both, R1/R2 with their middle to ground, LF output between the C3/C4 junction and ground. show_curve adds the S-curve (output against frequency, through zero at f0), typically only after answering.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema uten komponentverdier. Tertiærviklingen som mange forholdsdetektorer har, er utelatt.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0117 (before and after answering)

templates.title: Signal over tid
templates.description: Signals against time, computed from their definition and drawn as stacked panels: collector current in classes A/AB/B/C for a sine drive (conduction), a CW carrier keyed hard or softly (keying), the envelope of SSB speech, processed speech or RTTY with optional peak and average levels (envelope), an AM signal correctly modulated or overdriven with clipped peaks (am), a data signal with the carrier shifting between two frequencies (fsk), and the frequency of a keyed CW transmitter with or without chirp (chirp). 'blank' shows only a note, for figures shown after answering.
templates.idealised: Forenklede kurver som viser formen, ikke målinger fra et bestemt apparat.

templates.title: Frekvensspekter
templates.description: A frequency axis with discrete spectrum lines (harmonics, mixing products), sidebands as bands, a noise skirt around a carrier (phase noise) and an optional filter passband drawn over it. One or two panels share the axis. Levels are relative (0–1). 'blank' shows only a note, for spectra shown after answering.
templates.idealised: Forenklet spekter som viser hvor signalene ligger, ikke en måling.

templates.title: Halvleder
templates.description: Simplified drawings of the inside of a semiconductor: a silicon lattice with electron-pair bonds, optionally with a phosphorus atom (free electron) or boron atom (hole); a PN junction as a bar with holes, free electrons and the depletion layer with its fixed charges, optionally with anode/cathode, bias polarity, or a narrow and a wide layer compared (varicap); an N-channel JFET with gate regions and depletion layers, optionally at two gate voltages. 'blank' shows only a note, for drawings shown after answering.
templates.idealised: Forenklet tegning av prinsippet, ikke i riktig målestokk.

templates.title: Trinn og komponenter
templates.description: Small circuit diagrams with IEC-style symbols: class C stage with an RF choke to the base, push-pull stage with centre-tapped transformers, 7812 regulator (reveal: decoupling capacitors at its pins), single-transistor mixer (collector load '?', reveal: tuned to the MF), dual-gate MOSFET (gate 2 '?', reveal: small positive voltage, decoupled), triode (reveal: grid slightly negative, anode high positive, electron flow), PNP transistor (reveal: base about 0,6 V below the emitter) and a quartz crystal.
